text: Licence number MC-IN69455 appears on four separate credentials held by four different practising doctors — Dr. Lisa Gaines, Dr. Justin Watson, Dr. Susan Olson and Dr. Margaret Lee — all recorded against the Medical Council of India, and all four are actively billing. A licence is issued to one person; four billing identities behind one number is the credential-laundering signature, not a paperwork quirk. Honest duplicate-number collisions do occur in this data, but they involve two holders and stop there; four active holders on one number sits well outside that pattern. The alternative explanation is registry data-entry duplication propagated across four records, which would be unusual but is checkable. Next step: ask the Medical Council of India which holder the licence was actually issued to, and treat billing from the other three identities as unverified until it answers.
